title: BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents
summary: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents.
body: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了Bio-MemArt框架，一种用于多用户LLM智能体的生物识别感知KV缓存内存。在共享部署中，KV缓存作为LLM智能体的外部长期记忆，但存在访问控制问题。Bio-MemArt为每个KV内存块附加生物识别模板，并使用当前用户的生物识别探针进行过滤，仅在授权的候选池内运行检索和复用流程。这在保留原有功能的同时，增加了物理用户访问控制。实验表明，该方法在区分所有者和非所有者查询方面表现出色，并将预填充令牌数从平均18,781.96大幅降低至28.57，有效维持了KV缓存的低令牌运行模式。
